pages.text: Mushrooms grow on stumps and trunks in the woods: a Hunter levels from foraging them. Many cook into meals, and some brew into potions.$(br2)Naturalist's wild animals drop hides, fur, fat, teeth and antlers for Hunters. Some of them bite back.
A $(item)capture net$() catches butterflies, fireflies and other small creatures, and a Hunter levels from each catch.$(br2)Farmers level from picking ripe Croptopia crops and fruit by hand.
